subject: Request: Exec sign-off for Hosted API pricing exception >20% discount
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec sign-off for Hosted API pricing exception >20% discount

Karthik / Marissa / Laura —

Quick background: MedaPro (contact: Andrew Hayes) is ready to commit to a 12-month Hosted API contract with a projected average of ~120M tokens/mo (see attached forecast). They’ve asked for a 30% off-listed-unit-rate concession across the first 12 months to make the economics work on their side. Gross contract value at list would be ~$540k ARR; with a 30% concession we’d be ~ $378k (net new).

Why this is strategic: MedaPro is an enterprise healthcare SaaS with a sizable footprint in EMR integrations. If we secure them now, they’re likely to migrate additional models and move to Dedicated in 12–18 months (high expansion potential).

What I’m asking: We need executive sign-off for a pricing exception greater than 20% (they’re asking 30%). Deal desk prefers we avoid >20% without exec approval. Attached: usage forecast, draft SOW, pricing summary.

Proposed compromise options I recommend:
- Approve up to 25% off list for a 12-month commitment and require a quarterly usage review + 30-day ramp clause.
- Or approve 30% off if MedaPro signs a 24-month commitment with an escalation clause after month 12.

Risks: higher unit subsidy in year 1; needs legal to accept our standard data retention and security addendum (they’ve signaled acceptable).

Next steps: requesting a fast turnaround — MedaPro expects final terms by end of week. Can we get an exec decision?

Attachments: MedaPro_usage_forecast.xlsx, Draft_SOW_MedaPro.pdf, Pricing_summary_DLR8792.csv

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec sign-off for Hosted API pricing exception >20% discount

Aditya —

Forwarding Jonas’ summary and attachments. Short ask: MedaPro asks for 30% off list for Hosted API unit pricing on a 12-month commit (deal DL-8792-MP). Deal desk policy: discounts >20% require exec approval.

Our assessment:
- Risk profile: moderate (net subsidy in year 1)
- Upside: customer references + meaningful chance to convert to Dedicated in 12–18 months
- Recommendation: approve 25% now (keeps headroom) OR approve 30% only if they sign 24-month commit with a performance/usage escalation clause.

Can you weigh in with sign-off or counter? They want an answer by Fri 3/31 EOD PST.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec sign-off for Hosted API pricing exception >20% discount

Thanks for the concise summary — I reviewed the forecast and the deal economics. I’m comfortable approving an exception above the 20% threshold, but with guardrails:

1) Approve a flat 25% off list Hosted API unit rate for a 12-month commitment, effective for the first 12 months only.
2) Include a quarterly usage review and a 30-day ramp clause: if usage falls >30% below forecast at any quarterly check, pricing will revert to a higher tier or refunds/credits will be adjusted.
3) If the customer signs a 24-month commitment, we can go to 30% for the first 12 months (conditioned on legal accepting standard terms).

Reasoning: 25% hits the ask for meaningful concession while limiting downside. We preserve a lever to expand to 30% if we secure a longer commitment. Laura — please confirm there are no finance or legal flags on this approach.

Aditya
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for Hosted API pricing exception >20% discount

Andrew —

Thanks again for the fast turnaround on details and for sharing your usage forecast. Good news: our leadership has approved a pricing exception.

Approved terms (summary):
- 25% off our listed Hosted API unit rate for the first 12 months, effective on signature.
- Quarterly usage reviews; if usage is >30% below the forecast in any quarter, we reserve the right to revisit pricing (standard ramp/adjustment clause in SOW).
- If MedaPro is willing to move to a 24-month commitment, we can increase the initial discount to 30% for months 1–12 (subject to standard legal terms).

I’ve attached an updated SOW and pricing summary for signature (Draft_SOW_MedaPro.pdf). If this looks good, please loop in your procurement and we’ll issue a final DocuSign. We’d like to lock terms this week to meet the customer onboarding window.

Next steps:
1) You sign the updated SOW or confirm changes by reply.
2) Once signed, legal will issue final doc and we’ll book the order.

Appreciate the partnership — look forward to getting MedaPro onboarded.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102
